$comment: Comprehension question bank for Daily Comprehension (#353): DATA shared by iOS, Android and desktop. Each tree holds its own generated copy (ios/tools/gen_comprehension_bank.py writes the three source tables) and a test per tree asserts the copy equals this file. Order matters: it is part of day selection, so inserting or reordering items changes every future day's puzzle. See docs/daily-comprehension-design.md. kochLevel = 1 + the highest position, in MorseCode.kochOrder, of any letter in the sentence.
